case_studies.name: Samia
case_studies.teaser: 12 years of medical treatments had not helped her mental illness

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Samia was a recovering alcoholic who suffered great mental illness for a number of years. She was experiencing burnout and could not work. Her husband had suddenly asked for a divorce and she completely broke down. She moved countries to cope. He mental state was extremely fragile and she saw no hope for the future.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: When I met Samia through a friend’s referral I was extremely concerned for her wellbeing. That very day I started her healing and my main goal was to get her to be a bit stable and feel some calm and peace within herself. At the end of that first session Samia seemed like a different person. Color returned to her cheeks and she actually smiled. In the subsequent weeks I dove deep into healing her past lives, her childhood and her family situation. Both her adult daughters were distant from her as the entire family had been thorough many years of difficulty. Her husband had moved on and that broke her.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: Within 2 weeks her daughter with whom she shared the house went from being angry and totally ignoring her mother to sitting in bed with her and sharing life while going out together and building a new relationship. Within a month Samia and her husband got on the same page and their relationship became more than cordial. After each week of healing Samia became mentally and spiritually stronger, she began to get out of bed and began a gym routine. She went out and made friends. Her sleep returned and she would wake up refreshed. Her self love returned and she began to do things that made her happy. She received an offer from someone to work together which she accepted as it would be slow paced. Samia and I continue to work together and though there is still some work left to do Samia is unrecognizable to herself and to her family.

case_studies.name: Shaneze
case_studies.teaser: Moved countries and anxiety around my future

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Shaneze had moved to Dubai a year ago and had a difficult task of succeeding in a highly competitive market. She was unable to sleep and lacked self confidence and suffered from anxiety and deep fear.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: Samia referred her younger daughter whom she had moved in with. Knowing the history of the family well and getting to know Shaneze’s story, childhood trauma and feeling neglected and unloved needed to be healed. I needed to help instill her confidence and provide hope. Finances were very tight as there was no source of income in the new country.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: Shaneze worked very well with me and her intellect, maturity and desire to succeed were very helpful in her healing. She followed direction very well and moved beyond her limiting belief’s with ease. As her confidence soared she began attracting prospective clients and developing a strong network around her. Influential people reached out to her for partnerships. Even though her focus was establishing a business she wanted to have a loving committed relationship. Within 2 months she found a very suitable young man who treats her as she deserves. Overall Shaneze is feeling very stable, strong and looking forward to a great future ahead.

case_studies.name: Gurtej
case_studies.teaser: Feel stuck, need new direction in career

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Gurtej had many ideas, dreams and was very ambitious but something was holding him back. He wanted to break free from his engineering corporate job and become self employed but did not have clarity on how to move forward. He was also diagnosed with Celiac disease.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: Gurtej had been separated from his family at the tender age of 4 when he was adopted by his uncle so he could have a better life in Canada. That deep feeling of abandonment and lack of love, strong support and mentorship was missing from his life. Even though he developed resilience, the wounding was affecting him at the subconscious level. He could not move beyond his limiting belief’s. The healing sessions first addressed his rejection and abandonment wound and made space for expansion of his vision. A lot of time was spent on spiritual guidance as his mind opened to new frontiers for possibilities and manifestation.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: Overturning the Celiac diagnosis was a priority and the test that was already scheduled to be done a couple months after the healing sessions began provided amazing results- the markers went down from 93 to 17. The doctors were not able to explain this drastic improvement and Gurtej celebrated with his son by eating a Big Mac which he had to give up due to the Celiac diagnosis. He then received a promotion in a very desired role and is feeling happy and settled. He is still exploring starting a business and we are working on him gaining clarity and his why.

case_studies.name: Gary
case_studies.teaser: Fearful about the future

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Gary was transitioning into a new career and was concerned about his success in this venture and finances to support his family. He also had some challenging relationships as well as alcohol and some substance addictions. His self confidence was low and he was feeling stuck. Being fearful was his default.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: Gary attended a talk I gave at his company and wanted to get healing for his situation. The first win came when he quit alcohol and the substances within the first couple weeks. As I worked on removing his soul blocks he began feeling a calm he had never experienced before. As we continued with the healing and spiritual counselling he began working through his limiting his belief’s and found forgiveness in his heart towards the family members he had conflict with. This gave him an additional level of peace. Helping him succeed in his new career was a priority. Regular weekly sessions of healing soon yielded great results. He began getting good attention on his social media, clients started getting in touch with inquiries and within a couple months he signed 3 deals back to back. Gary now is the best version of himself. His colleagues are totally in awe of him. He is full of gratitude, and has faith in himself and his ability to co-create his future exactly as he sees it. His confidence is at an all time high and he is working through his belief’s every day and his daily achievements and successes are a testament to all the great things that lie ahead.

case_studies.name: Stuart
case_studies.teaser: Being sued by TD bank

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: A past client called me to say that her husband who own a gas station was being accused by a major bank with whom his business shares a wall, that there was avery toxic smell in their premises likely due to a petrol was leak and the bank needed to be closed due to danger to their clients and staff. If proven to be the culprit, they would lose everything they had worked for their entire lives. The environmental authorities had begun investigations and soil samples and others were sent for testing. He had to close his business and was losing money daily while paying thousands of dollars for these testes that were being done by the government.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: I took on the case but the pressure to heal and clear all issues within a short period of time was very critical. The other difficulty was that Stuart does not believe in healing or felt that this modality could help him. After a conversation though he was skeptical he gave his consent to me to proceed with the healing. I dove into deep healing of Stuart including generational and familial karma. There were many energetic and karmic blocks that were creating this and other issues in his life. His relationship with his wife were very strained too. He took it very hard as one can imagine and informed me that the servant had left their employment a couple years ago.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: The government had ordered multiple tests of the soil as well as the drums to see if there was leakage from there. The bank closed it’s doors for over a month and was looking at serious legal action towards Stuart and his business. After 6 sessions of healing every test result was negative and clear and the bank reopened for business. No explanation for the smell was ever found and the problem seemed to disappear as if by magic. Stuart was beyond relieved and happy with the result. His entire life’s work and savings were protected. Testimonial Ajita you saved me and my family I will never be able to repay what you did for me. No one thought I would come out of this. Thank you seems so feeble. What you do is amazing, keep up the great work.

case_studies.name: Sundip
case_studies.teaser: Success had eluded me and my relationships have caused me so much suffering

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Sundip has been an aspiring actor for many years and though he got a couple small roles in web series, he had not been able to get any substantial roles or be recognized for his talents. As he has a good voice he became a voice over artist and resigned to this fate. He was referred to me by a client whom I have worked with in my extended program and she kept insisting he work with me. Sundip has worked with a few psychologists and healers in the past and was reluctant as he had not gained anything from those sessions. Finally he relented and began working with me. He had numerous big blocks related to his childhood, almost all his significant and intimate relationships had been superficial and toxic creating a very low vibrational state within him. He had self-confidence issues and a great need to people please and be accepted. Inspite of being a very loving and giving person he had no stability nor happiness in his life. His financial crunch and lack of progress in his chosen field of work was causing him great distress.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: There were a lot of layers of healing that were required. I began with his childhood and parental relationship. Cleaned latent deep seated feelings within the soul, mind and body of unworthiness, rejection, limiting belief’s and so much more. Cleared all energies from his past intimate relationships that were blocking the flow of positive energy. It was very important to find the reasons for the lack of success even thoughts he had all the skills and traits required for a good actor. Painstakingly I began unravelling that through an innate intuitive process.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: Sundip began to see results almost immediately. The first big win was that within a couple weeks he took his first international trip to Europe. Cleaning his energetic body of his past relationships enabled him to disconnect from the women physically and energetically and discontinue toxic cycles of energy exchange and repeated cycles. Within 4 weeks he began to get auditions and roles in movies. Talent scouts and others began to notice him and refer him to their contacts. Big directors were responding to him and within 4 months he had 3 movie roles and for 1 he travelled to Italy to shoot. His relationship with his father has improved. He is far more patient with him and they are being more a family and spending quality time together. Daily new professional contacts are being made and his prospects for new movies is increased exponentially. This is just the beginning for him. He has a very bright future ahead of him, and we continue to work together.

case_studies.name: Michelle
case_studies.teaser: Need to quit a 25 year pot habit

This part time job gave her the flexibility to work on setting up her financial consulting business with WFG. Due my travels and health issues I was unable to work with Michele for 2 months from Jan 2023- March 2023. March 13th we resumed with gusto and my focus now was the pot. Easter 2023 ( April) Michelle smoked her last joint and it is now 6 months she has not touched pot nor has had any desire to do so. She is completely free of her alcohol cravings too and is on a spiritual path now. Her bank account is looking much healthier and she is working hard to set up her financial business.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: Michelle is free of any substance abuse and has a job she loves and where she is loved. This allows to take care of herself financially. She continues to work on her wellbeing and spiritual growth while focusing on her future wealth growth. She is happy and loving herself. Her relationships with her mother and siblings has greatly improved and she feels far more seen and supported by them. Her future is very bright!

case_studies.name: Maddy
case_studies.teaser: I don’t want to have my Kidney stone surgery tomorrow morning

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Severe pain due to large kidney stone and she was set up for surgery at 8 am next morning. She called me as she did not want to go through surgery.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: It was Sunday evening 8 pm and I had just returned from a day out and was reading dinner. Normally I would never answer a phone call at that time of the night but I was guided to do so and it was Maddy sounding really bad calling from her hospital bed sobbing. Maddy told me she had a very large kidney stone and was due for surgery within 12 hours but shoe did not want to go ahead with it, and asked me to help her to not have the surgery in the morning. I was quite shocked by her request as it seemed irresponsible to cancel and seemingly much required surgery. Also due to the too late hour to cancel surgery that was scheduled less than 12 hours away with all preparations that would have be made and everything in place to go ahead including surgeons, operating theatres, anesthetists etc Her daughter and son who are doctors were by her side. She was very insistent I help her and reluctantly I agreed. I asked my husband to order dinner and I began an hour long healing process clearing all her blockages and clearing a path to the surgery being cancelled in the morning and her being sent home. Also my main focus was that her pain subside and the stone pass naturally and painlessly as soon as possible.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: I spoke to Maddy at11:00 am the next morning and she informed me that the doctors had somehow decided to cancel the surgery and were sending her home after another dose of morphine and other drugs in the hope that she would pass the stone naturally in the next few days. She is now pain free with no kidney stones.

case_studies.name: Mobeka
case_studies.teaser: Help my sister suffers from depression and autoimmune hepatitis

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Deeply unhappy recently diagnosed with autoimmune hepatitis, Diabetes, obesity, high blood pressure, in a severe financial crunch. Was holding a deep dark secret- sexual abuse for 8 years by a home teacher which she had never shared with anyone.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: Mobeka was referred to me by her sister who had seen amazing results with the healing her mother had experienced with me. When I first spoke to Marietta she was in a very helpless state. Her health was failing and the autoimmune hepatitis diagnosis which has no cure was causing her great anxiety. The first thing she said to be was- “I feel like snakes are crawling inside me, I cannot stand it” She mentioned to me that she had not felt happiness for the last 20 years. She was feeling stuck in her career and was in a part time position not making enough money to make her ends meet. Even though she was married to a good man she was feeling very unfulfilled in that marriage and had no children. Her relationship with her parents and sister was also very strained and she felt unloved and uncared for and put down all the time. After a couple of weeks when she felt secure enough with me, Mobeka shared a very painful part of her life- when she was 10 years old her home tutor began to inappropriately touch her which went on until she was 18 years old. She had never shared this with anybody and had continued to carry the pain and the shame all by herself.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: Mobeka dove into the healing sessions with me with great commitment. She followed all my instructions, did her meditations and other practices that I prescribed diligently. The first thing that happened was the snakes she felt slithering inside her body quietened down. Within the first couple of weeks even though she had traveled back to India from London and was surrounded by family and related stress she actually managed it a lot better than she had in the past. In 4 weeks her anxiety cleared the lot and she began to feel hopeful for her future. 6 weeks into her healing program she had a doctor’s appointment where they were very happy with her test results. When she came to me she had been prescribed 3 immunosuppressant tablets a day but during that visit the doctor reduced her dosage to one tablet a day. Her diabetes and blood pressure were within the normal range as well. when she told me that she was beginning to feel happy, something that she had not felt in the last 20 years. On the career front- she was filling in a temporary position for a woman who was transferred to a different department. After 10 sessions Mobeka was informed that she was being made permanent and full-time in her current position with a nice pay increase. After she shared her sexual trauma with me we explored whether it was safe and wise to share it with her husband and she was to think about it and we were to discuss its merits the following week in our session. But within an hour she messaged me that she had already told her husband. He had been very supportive but was extremely angry with the person who had caused her all this pain. Mobeka was very happy and relieved that she no longer needed to hide or keep this big secret from her husband. Through the work that we were doing and all the counseling she was receiving she began to feel stronger within herself and learn to stand up when her family did not treat her right. Her deep rooted issues eroded her self confidence which improved tremendously and she was more assertive at work and that allowed her to be seen and she began getting more responsibilities and her prospects increased. Thrilled with her 3 month results Mobeka wanted to continue working on her personal growth so enrolled in my extended program. We began to work on her weight issues and other aspects that required healing. She continues her evolutionary journey, her health issues are well under control and shines.

Her daughter readily agreed to cancel the travels and asked me to take on her mother as a client and heal her back to normal. I took Mary on for a 3 month program and began used my HIIH healing process to help her.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: Soon after the first healing session Marta’s daughter sent me 2 photographs- 1st was of Marta on her birthday 3 weeks before the healing session. 2nd one was a couple days after the healing. As I had never seen Mary or seen her picture I could not understand what I was looking at. There were 2 women who were very different but I could not understand why I was sent those images. Then Marta’s daughter pointed out that both the women were Marta. A few weeks later Marta was beginning to socialize, take care of herself, stopped being a couch potato and even her temperament was calm and not combative anymore. The turnaround was just unbelievable. Her leg pain is a lot better as is her shoulder. Interestingly Marta finally took the trip to the UK to meet her 2nd daughter about 3 months after I finished her healing and as she was picking up her bags she fell. As I had predicted to her older daughter. Luckily she was totally unhurt and there is no doubt that she was uninjured because of the healing. If she had travelled as was originally planned her injuries would have been significant.

case_studies.name: Gloria
case_studies.teaser: Arthritis has twisted my hands and I cannot even walk

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Gloria a lovely 75 year old lady referred by my neighbour came into my office one afternoon. Her husband had brought her and she could barely walk dragging her feet on the ground, literally. She suffered from arthritis and had very swollen knees and her hands and fingers were twisted due to the disease. To make matters worse she had had a fall and her left shoulder and arm was in a lot of pain. In speaking with Gloria I found out that her husband many years ago had walked out on her and her 2 little boys without a word and till date she had not heard from him or had no information of his whereabouts. That was in Singapore and it was an extremely traumatic time for her. Subsequently she married again and her husband is a wonderful caring and loving man. Both make a loving couple.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: In speaking with Gloria I found out that her husband many years ago had walked out on her and her 2 little boys without a word and till date she had not heard from him or had no information of his whereabouts. That was in Singapore and it was an extremely traumatic time for her. Subsequently she married again and her husband is a wonderful caring and loving man. Both make a loving couple.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: She was no longer coy and she sashayed into my office. Her husband followed beaming. And I watched in awe. Gloria is fully functional with no pain or tingling in her arms or legs. She had regained her movement and her way of life! Subsequently they invited me to cleanse their house. Today I am happy to call them my friends. After the first session Gloria felt some calm, and reduction in the tingling feeling. But nothing earth shattering. That is not bad, in my books ? The next session, I worked on removing the trauma of all those years ago, feeling the rejection of her husband suddenly leaving and having to raise 2 very young boys alone. I then did a soul separation from her estranged husband so her soul could be finally free of him. After the second session she messaged me to inform me that she had managed to do her own manicure and painted her nails red. A lady who could not as much as make her bed or do dishes was able to regain dexterity enough to do such fine movements was very heart warming. Also the tingling in her left arm had reduced. She also felt like a weight had been lifted off her. Her husband happened to mention that he too was feeling better and different even though he was not being treated by me. The advantage of healing is that as the energy within an individual shifts the energy around them shifts too and they themselves along with the people around them feel the difference for the better. And also life improves drastically. After the 3rd session the pain in Gloria’s left arm, the swelling and pain in the knees, the tingling all continued to reduce substantially. Movement and dexterity in her hands also improved significantly. As I opened the door for them for the 4th session, I was hit by a radiant light and a breeze that seemed to be emitted by Gloria. Her demeanor completely changed. Subsequently they invited me to their home to bless and clean the energy- I found some unexpected things and energies there Story for another day. Testimonial: I was referred to Ajita by a friend who highly recommended her. I was in a lot of pain due to Arthritis and a subsequent fall, when I first met Ajita. Through her administering healing, the pain quickly subsided and I have resumed my normal life and activities. My arthritic hands which were rigid before the healing, now I have almost 100% mobility. The most surprizing thing for me was to learn that my arthritis was due to the pain I was holding as to my husband abandoned my sons and me during my early days. Her accurate diagnosis of this hidden trauma and subsequent treatment has me in awe. She is very professional in what she does and I would not hesitate to recommend her to anyone. Gloria Chia Team Director- Remax

case_studies.name: P G Gerald
case_studies.teaser: 8 yr old girls trauma of sexual abuse

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: A client in one session mentioned his 8 yr old daughter who was still throwing temper tantrums and the biggest problem was she would not eat, especially upon returning from school. He asked if I could do some healing for her.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: Due to her age I did not expect her to in a session with me and so at a time when she slept I did one treatment for her. As I was working through her traumas and blocks I saw that she had been inappropriately touched numerous times by a man servant while he fed her. Eating reminded her of that shameful act and she would act out through tantrums and being fussy with food.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: I had the very hard task of informing her father of the issue that was affecting his daughter. He took it very hard as one can imagine and informed me that the servant had left their employment a year ago. Thankfully balance was restored in the little girl’s life and her tantrum ended, she went back to being a normal 8 year old. Testimonial: I consulted Ajita for my 8 year old daughter who was throwing tantrums often, especially during meal times. Through distance healing Ajita found the core problem to be sexual abuse by a male help at home. Even though I was heart broken as a father I was grateful that my daughter got the help she needed to clear that trauma from her system. I am forever in her debt!

case_studies.name: Anetta
case_studies.teaser: My unlucky house sold by 100k over asking in a depressed market

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Anetta was very unhappy in her house that had caused both her husband and her to lose their jobs as soon as they bought it and even before they moved in. They deemed the house very unlucky. They had lived in it for over 10 years and everything that could possibly go wrong did. They both lost their jobs soon after buying this house and even before they moved in. And thereafter were severely cash strapped in spite of finally getting good jobs and being extremely talented and skilled. The couple’s relationship suffered severely and they fought constantly. Their children lived in a very toxic environment and were emotionally neglected. For 8 years they could not agree to sell this house. The wife knew they needed to move but the husband’s logical mind did not agree. Finally she contacted me.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: First I worked on synchronizing the couple’s energies and cleansing them of all trauma they had suffered. This helped bring the couple together and they started to communicate much better and could see each other’s point of view. Then I cleansed the house and the property. Soon after the couple agreed that they would at least start doing some research into the housing market and see what was available in the market that they could afford. After 1 winter season they resumed their search and hired a realtor. As luck would have it they found their dream home within 3 weeks and bought it right away. Fortunately for the husband this house allowed them to make a lateral move. So they had no financial strain in buying and moving. After purchasing their new house I was invited to cleanse the house and property for prosperity and peace. Now came the task of selling their own house. They prepped it and decided to price it a bit higher than the market. The house in itself was extremely well designed and beautiful.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: To the amazement of all, this house sold for over $100,000 from the asking price within 2 hours of it going on sale. Ever since the healing sessions the couple has enjoyed a much more congenial relationship and their children are close with them now. They bought their dream home and sold their old home for way more than even the market would dictate. They now live in their new home and things are progressing very well. Their businesses are flourishing, they are much happier as a couple and family and they are also planning to upgrade the house next year. As there was so much trauma I worked with the children too, to heal them of the pain and hurt. Thankfully this couple and their family were finally able to leave that unfortunate house they lived in for 10 years behind and are now living the life they so well deserve. Testimonial Getting 100k over asking was an unexpected and very pleasant shock to everyone. The market was not supporting a sale within the first day or even for more than asking price. We know for sure that Ajita and her magic made it all happen. She is so kind and attentive and the extra money allowed us to buy our dream home. We are ever grateful to Ajita and her special gifts!

case_studies.name: Juan
case_studies.teaser: My employees negativity is disrupting my business

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Within Juan’s business team trouble was brewing. One of the team members Hubert was very negative, aggressive and rude and it was affecting overall morale and business. Hubert is inherently a very negative individual prone to angry outburst. For him everything that happens is someone else’s fault and plays the blame game constantly. Things finally came to a head and my client asked Hubert to leave. Unfortunately Hubert was very valuable to the team as he had been at the job for 7 years and would not be easy to replace. Hubert had his own family situation and really needed this job. So my client called me that very day extremely upset and angry. He was angry at the behaviour of Hubert and also upset at how his departure would affect his bottom line.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: I started by treating the relationship between my client and Hubert and removing blocks between them and synchronising their energies. The next day Hubert came on his own accord to the office and apologized and asked for his job back. Till date he is playing well with the team and this negativity has reduced drastically. This makes the entire environment much more conducive and productive. He is following instructions well and without unnecessary arguments. My client is very happy and his business is on track and his team is intact and functioning.

case_studies.name: Wolfgang
case_studies.teaser: Child services have taken away my daughter

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: His 8 year old daughter had been taken away from class by children’s services as the teacher found a suicide not in her bag. The child was taken away on a Thursday and parents had no access to her as it was a safety issue for the child. With the weekend around the corner they were really concerned that their child would not be processed adequately and she would be away from them indefinitely.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: It was a hard case because the child was adopted and the birth mother was not known. Normally when I have to heal a young child I find it is important to first work with the mother to better understand the deeper underlying issues with her and why her child is suffering before resolving the issues with the child. As this was a very delicate situation and emotions were very high, I utilized many extraordinary processes to heal and clear the reasons that were creating the separation with the adopted parents. I also worked on the child to eliminate her fears and angst she was feeling.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: On Monday the child was released to the parents unexpectedly while the investigation into the note and the situation at home and why the child was writing such notes continued. Normally a child is never returned until the agency is 100% sure the child is not in any danger and there are no hidden threats. The child is thriving and happy and there has been no recurrence.

case_studies.name: Kris
case_studies.teaser: I was tortured by my mother since childhood, even at 52 she is still impacting me

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: His mother was a very narcissistic person and he left home at 16 due to the treatment he received from his mother. Even after living away, being married and having a daughter, his mother was treating everyone in the same toxic way. Kris had developed a lot of anxiety, lacked confidence and was over all tired of life. He kept getting overlooked for promotion and his professional relationships were sour.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: There was a lot to clear, the long years of sadness and helplessness had affected his soul and energy blocking him from joy and prosperity. I worked on him to sync his energies to his superiors and co workers to improve working relationships and increase his prospects for success. I provided many tools and strategies to deal with his mother and also aligned him and his family to be more positive and cohesive together. I tackled all the issues that were ailing him individually to create an overall feeling of harmony and peace.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: The first thing Kris experienced was a sense of peace that replaced his constant feelings of dread and doom. This allowed him to sleep well at night and have more energy an positivity during the day and his dealings with everyone. He poured his heart out something he had never done so he felt lighter and it allowed me to give him tools and strategies to deal with himself and his mother. This brought about a lot of calm and confidence into his persona and life. With each week of healing he began shedding deep help emotions, negativity, fear, dread and his body and mind began to react. His pains and other symptoms began to dissipate. One other noteworthy thing that happened was that the psoriasis on his legs cleared. He had had this condition for over 35 years and had never worn shorts and 1 month after his first sessions he wore shorts to the golf course. Testimonial: Initially I was quite apprehensive but open to experience healing for the first time, I was comfortable as it came from a strong reference. Just the first two sessions with Ajita had me transported to an unbelievable world of rejuvenation and the most incredible experience of my life. It was undoubtedly life changing for me. I felt I was a new born from within, there was a new zing in my life. My sleep patterns to energy levels were all hitting a new high. Ajitha has a wonderful professional approach to make you so comfortable, all you need is to trust in her and surrender yourself. What I liked the most is how the whole process is carried out in sync with your own faith, belief system, religious inclination etc. with zero interference to your private space. I have got freedom from a dozen aches and pains and ailments apart from brand new outlook to life. By the time I finished my fourth session I was a brand new person, feeling all light and happy ready for all challenges life had to throw at me. Thank you Ajita for transforming my life.

case_studies.name: Ines
case_studies.teaser: I have suffered from anxiety since I was 3 yrs old

sections.label: Issue
sections.text: Ines had been suffering from anxiety since she was 3 yrs old and now even at age 25 it is still experiencing multiple panic attacks daily. It was affecting her work and relationships while eroding her self confidence and she was just living that loop with no hope for a way out.

sections.label: Healing
sections.text: Her mental state was not allowing her to explore options in her life in work or even expand her horizons in areas that she was interested in. As I began healing her childhood and past life wounds she responded very well and within the first month she was more than 50% better. Ines was now confident in the decisions she was making at work and that debilitating feeling was now gone. Since a very young child Ines had the responsibility of looking after her mother who had addiction and mental health issues and needed constant attention. It was important to clear all her fears and the lack of love and support she experienced.

sections.label: Result
sections.text: Ines is now confident in the decisions she is making at work and that debilitating feelings are now gone. By month 2 she opened her mind to her interests in photography, acting and even began training for the Paris marathon. Her relationship with her boyfriend and father improved dramatically and just the calm and peace of knowing who she is and how much she could offer the world helps her thrive. Testimonial Ajita was recommended to me by my mother Samia, who is also her client, with whom she has done incredible work. The results are more than present: I started the sessions with a constant state of stress and anxiety which resulted in several panic attacks during the day. In two months, I went from this state to a state of well-being without any anxiety and with a wider range of possibilities for the future. Ajita is very caring, spiritual, professional and always there when you need her. If you want to feel better, get to know yourself and improve your life, I highly recommend Ajita!
